description: general/tab widget entry point: the Container/Component/FieldMapping(tabType) cluster every widget has. The richer Tabs::Tab / DefaultTab / per-pane Container mechanism this Component's Component::Tabs back-ref leads to is documented once, in tabs.json, rather than duplicated here.
notes: A fuller Tab widget carries Component::Tabs pointing at a Tabs node (Kind:"Tabs") that owns the actual pane list — omitted from THIS minimal entry to keep it self-consistent on its own; see tabs.json for the complete Component->Tabs->Tab->Container chain with that key populated, which is identical regardless of whether you reached the Component via this widget-palette entry or via any other page.

Real ids typically use the manifest_id prefix only on a fresh single-widget add (e.g. `Button_<10-char-rand>`, `Metrics_<10-char-rand>`) — the scenario this template mints for — while built-up production pages (`all_pages_draft_20260806.json`) mostly carry the generic `Component_<rand>` id instead, and Repeater/Tab/MasterDetail/Breadcrumbs were never observed prefixed at all.
